adaptable.name: Adaptable
adaptable.description: For 60 seconds, every skill improves twice as fast.

innate_focus.name: Innate Focus
innate_focus.description: For 20 seconds, spells cost half as much and hit 25% harder.

battle_fury.name: Battle Fury
battle_fury.description: For 15 seconds, deal 25% more damage and take 20% less.

blessing.name: Blessing
blessing.description: Restore 4 Health per second for 10 seconds.

steady_nerves.name: Steady Nerves
steady_nerves.description: For 12 seconds, take 20% less damage and recover Stamina 50% faster.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: Every enemy within 8 m reels, staggered.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.description: The enemy you're aiming at (within 40 m) takes 30% more from everything for 20 seconds.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Unseen for 8 seconds: enemies lose you. Attacking or casting ends it.

arcane_surge.name: Arcane Surge
arcane_surge.description: For 8 seconds, spells cost no Magicka.

quickened_blade.name: Quickened Blade
quickened_blade.description: Your ready spell goes into your blade at once, for no Magicka (a damage spell and a melee weapon; see Spell-blades).

shadow_feast.name: Shadow Feast
shadow_feast.description: For 20 seconds, a sneak attack heals you by half the damage it does.

moons_favour.name: Moon's Favour
moons_favour.description: For 60 seconds the tide is high for you, whatever the moons say.

storm_mantle.name: Storm Mantle
storm_mantle.description: For 15 seconds, enemies within 3 m of you take 8 damage a second.

call_the_host.name: Call the Host
call_the_host.description: For 2 minutes you can hold one more bound creature than usual.

second_breath.name: Second Breath
second_breath.description: Instantly recover half your Health and half your Stamina.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: For 20 seconds, you and your companions deal 25% more damage.

old_bargain.name: Old Bargain
old_bargain.description: Trade 30 Health for 60 Magicka. Not when it would kill you.
